0.0: Last up is Edelstein.\r\n#L0##bI have a question for you.#l\n#k
0.1: As long as it isn't math. That stuff is hard.\r\n#L0##bYou said you were going to have the Resistance install other devices, but they're in Edelstein. Do I really need to go back?#l\n#k
0.2: Ah, yes. Well, I thought you might want to go back to your home town, to see things through to the end. Once that device is installed, you should be safe there.

no.0: This is it. You'll be able to return to Edelstein once you're done.

1.1: You look well. Does the fact that you're standing in front of me right now mean you've taken care of that little problem you had?\r\n#L0##bIf I am lucky, yes. Our friends at the lab helped me.#l\n#k
1.2: Good. I was worried about you. Let's continue our conversation some other time, we may be under surveillance.

yes.0: #b#p2152009##k wanted to know when you'd return. You should go find her if you can.
